d0_semantics: same-provider diagnostic source reconstruction; not normal Expert reconstruction
d1_semantics: replay frozen native CanonicalControlTarget and AppliedControl stream; do not recompute controller
d2_semantics: replay frozen RequestedAction sequence and recompute controller from target live state; diagnostic schedule remains source-authored; label DIAGNOSTIC_D2_FROZEN_ACTION_EXECUTION
environment_termination_semantics: source runner records false/false; replay runtime has no Gym terminated/truncated return, so replay reports null and action-sequence exhaustion independently
original_expert_state: failure and original failed gate preserved; never converted to pass
progression_owner: separate DiagnosticShadowCoordinator; canonical Expert is not mutated or reset
progression_rule: continue only authored next-stage plans after nonterminal Expert gate failure
task_artifact_identity: rate-specific canonical TaskArtifact; fixed 0.002s physics step
